description: Matières résiduelles - bilan massique is a dataset listed in City of Montréal open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Cet ensemble présente le bilan massique annuel de la gestion des matières résiduelles pour l'agglomération de Montréal. Coverage: Montréal. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are CRD, Déchet, Matière compostable, Matière organique, Matière recyclable. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2026-06-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-montreal-portal.
